event: Nala keeps listening as the day goes on: the woman hums, low voices come and go, none deep.
prose: You keep listening. The woman above hums through most of the day, and now and then she talks with someone, light voices, a laugh, footsteps going off. The deep one doesn't come back.

event: She sleeps and wakes several times, listening each time she wakes; the deep voice stays away.
prose: You sleep, and wake, and listen, and sleep again. Each time you wake you go straight to the voices, and each time it is the humming, or quiet, or someone light and quick.

event: She wakes to the deep voices back beside her, talking low, as they were the morning before.
prose: Then you wake to deep voices beside you again, talking low and easy, the way they did the morning before.

event: A heavy hand settles on the belly over her, and the deep voice starts its run again, slow and close.
prose: A heavy hand settles over you, and the deep voice starts its run, slow and close.

event: This time she holds it whole: three sounds, Sa, then vo, then reth, the same each time.
prose: This time you have it. Three sounds: Sa, then vo, then reth. It comes the same each time, and on the second time through you are already saying it along with him in your head.

event: On the next repeat she opens her mouth and works her tongue to make the shape back.
prose: On the next repeat you open your mouth and work your tongue to make it back.

event: Her mouth opens and closes on it, but no sound comes; only warm fluid where a voice would be.
prose: Your mouth opens and closes around the shape. Nothing comes out. There is only the warm fluid where your breath should be, moving a little as your jaw moves.

event: Her tongue manages Sa and vo; the reth at the end, a curl and a hiss, will not come.
prose: Your tongue finds Sa, and then vo. The reth at the end needs a curl and a hiss, and your tongue won't curl that far.

event: The deep voice stops; the woman above says the three sounds back, softly, stroking the belly.
prose: The deep voice stops. Above you the woman says it back, soft and slow: "Sa-vo-reth." Her hand strokes over the belly, over you, as she says it.
